description: 试点 1,000 条（分层抽样，多版本对比）+ 全量打标第四版 1,000 条（开源）
description_en: 1,000 pilot traces (stratified, several annotation versions) + 1,000 traces from the full v4 run (open release)
about_html:
TraceAtlas 是一份带结构标注的长思维链语料。为什么做这个：社区缺少高质量、带结构标注的思维链（CoT）数据。我们用一个很强的开源教师模型（Qwen3.8-27B，能力大致相当于 Opus 4.6）生成数学题的完整推理轨迹，再逐段标注它的推理结构，希望整理成一份可以复用的公开语料。

这里展示的是数学题教师轨迹（Qwen3.8-27B 思考模式）的推理结构标注。思考内容按段落切分， 每段属于一个推理节点；节点有功能标签（Setup / Plan / Recall / Compute / Explore / Verify / Monitor / Consolidate / Answer） 和路径属性：主路径（最终推导用到的内容，以及答案之前的设定、复述和计划）、探索（没有进入最终推导的尝试：明确放弃的 A 和没用上的死胡同 D，合并计算）、答案之后（答案第一次确定之后的复查、替代证明、写作规划）。

标注来源：27B·v4（Qwen3.8-27B-FP8 思考模式；长轨迹先全局概括再分块标注）、27B·v3、27B·v1，以及 GPT-6.1·v1（OpenRouter 上的 GPT-6.1 Sol，第一版提示词，只有主路径/被放弃两类，作为参照）。这些都是模型标注，不是人工标注。
about_html_en:
TraceAtlas is a corpus of long chain-of-thought traces with structural annotations. Why: the community lacks high-quality chain-of-thought (CoT) data with structural annotations. We generate full reasoning traces for math problems with a strong open teacher model (Qwen3.8-27B, roughly comparable to Opus 4.6) and label their reasoning structure paragraph by paragraph, aiming to build a reusable public corpus.

This site shows structural annotations of teacher reasoning traces (Qwen3.8-27B, thinking mode) on math problems. Each trace's thinking is split into paragraphs; every paragraph belongs to a reasoning node with a function label (Setup / Plan / Recall / Compute / Explore / Verify / Monitor / Consolidate / Answer) and a path: main path (what the final derivation uses, plus setup, restating and planning before the answer), exploration (attempts that did not make it into the final derivation: explicitly abandoned A and unused dead ends D, counted together), and post-answer (re-checks, alternative proofs and write-up planning after the answer was first reached).

Annotation sources: 27B·v4 (Qwen3.8-27B-FP8 in thinking mode; long traces are first outlined globally, then labeled in chunks), 27B·v3, 27B·v1, and GPT-6.1·v1 (GPT-6.1 Sol via OpenRouter, first prompt version with only main/abandoned, used as a reference). All are model annotations, not human annotations.
